Multiple Earthquakes Strike Peru, Mexico, and New Zealand

Multiple earthquakes were reported across the globe. A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck central Peru, with reports of five deaths and 21 injuries. In Mexico, a 7.3 to 7.4 magnitude earthquake hit off the coast near the Guatemala border, prompting a tsunami alert, though no immediate damage was reported. Separately, a 6.3 magnitude earthquake shook New Zealand's South Island, leading to a tsunami alert that was later lifted.
